## Before opening this pull request

HeyTim currently accepts issues and focused proposals but does not accept
unsolicited implementation pull requests. Link the maintainer-approved issue or
proposal for this change:

Closes #

## What changed

Describe the user-visible outcome and the smallest implementation that delivers
it.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran the relevant commands from `README.md`.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I updated documentation and generated contracts when applicable.
- [ ] I did not add credentials, customer data, signing material, or generated secrets.
- [ ] I reviewed the license and contribution policy in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
